description_en: Queries the change logs for cluster configurations
description_zh: 查看集群配置变更记录
kebab_example: aliyun selectdb describe-db-cluster-config-change-logs --config-key be.conf --db-cluster-id selectdb-cn-7213c80000-be --db-instance-id selectdb-cn-7213c80000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --start-time 2023-04-25_09:48:23 --end-time 2023-05-08_15:59:59 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDBClusterConfigChangeLogs

parameters.help_en: The configuration file that was modified. The value is \`be.conf\` for a compute cluster and \`fe.conf\` for an FE cluster
parameters.help_zh: 修改的配置项文件，计算集群固定为be.conf，FE集群固定为fe.conf
parameters.name: config_key

parameters.help_en: The start time to query change logs. The format is \`yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss\`
parameters.help_zh: 变更记录查询的起始时间。格式形如：yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time to query change logs. The format is \`yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss\`
parameters.help_zh: 变更记录查询的截止时间。格式形如：yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
parameters.name: end_time
